canada.title: Moncton man charged in child luring case has 'spent time in' 5 provinces, RCMP say
canada.summary: New Brunswick RCMP have released the photo of a Moncton man facing several charges in connection with a child luring investigation, as well as a list of communities he has "spent time in" across Canada to encourage people with information to come forward.

canada.title: Montreal police use tear gas to disperse downtown student protest
canada.summary: Montreal police deployed tear gas and moved to disperse crowds Friday afternoon after a student demonstration led to clashes with officers clad in riot gear.

canada.title: Judge warns against ‘rumours and innuendo’ before Galloway trial witness testifies
canada.summary: VANCOUVER - The judge in the trial of author Steven Galloway’s defamation lawsuit has cautioned that testimony from a University of British Columbia official can’t refer to “rumours and innuendo” about Galloway.

canada.title: Manitoba may need to spend far less on new power generation: Kinew
canada.summary: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew says the province may need to spend far less than previously thought on new power plants based on Manitoba Public Utilities Board information.

canada.title: Manitoba group needs $17M to bring 3,000 Indigenous artefacts home
canada.summary: A Manitoba-based organization is trying to raise $17 million to bring 3,000 Indigenous artefacts home from Switzerland.

canada.title: 3 dead after boat crash in flooded river near Squamish, B.C.
canada.summary: Three people are confirmed dead after a boat crashed on the Squamish River on Thursday.

canada.title: PHAC finds no evidence of mystery brain disease in New Brunswick, says patients still need answers
canada.summary: The Public Health Agency of Canada (PHAC) says it has found no evidence of a mystery brain disease that was allegedly affecting hundreds of New Brunswick residents.

canada.title: Defence hammers RCMP officer over lack of specifics in interview of man accused of 1st-degree murder
canada.summary: Terry Cole told an RCMP officer that Matthew Kavanagh killed Michael Fillier, but his defence lawyer pointed out on Friday that the officer didn't ask for any specific details that could have confirmed his account.

canada.title: ‘Intent is to try to appeal’ encampment cleanup order, Saskatoon organization says
canada.summary: Station 20 West says it received a notice to remove the encampment in front of its 20th Street facility from the City of Saskatoon but will not comply until the two parties meet.

canada.title: Family, police believe missing Ontario teen is in Sask.
canada.summary: On Friday, Saskatchewan RCMP shared a news release on behalf of Durham Regional Police asking for the public's help finding Cairo. The 14-year-old was last seen in Courtice, about an hour outside Toronto, on Sept. 20.

canada.title: Woman charged with arson in $1M West Broadway apartment blaze: Winnipeg police
canada.summary: A 40-year-old woman has been arrested and charged with arson after Winnipeg police allege she started a Thursday fire in a Young Street apartment block that caused an estimated $1 million in damage.

canada.title: N.S. RCMP say they’ve stopped a man who allegedly went on a two-week crime spree
canada.summary: Police in Nova Scotia say a 29-year-old man is facing multiple charges after allegedly going on a two-week crime spree across the southwest part of the province.

canada.title: Woman, 2 children dead after collision on eastern Alberta highway
canada.summary: A 37-year-old woman was pronounced dead on scene and two children died from their injuries after being transported to hospital. One child remains in critical condition, according to RCMP.

canada.title: Stelco to recall 175 laid-off workers in Hamilton, Ont., on Dec. 1
canada.summary: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc. said Friday it had secured enough customer commitments to restart finishing operations at Stelco’s Hamilton plant, with all affected employees to be recalled on Dec. 1.

canada.title: Nova Scotia Power’s $1 Billion Mortgage: How much should future ratepayers shoulder?
canada.summary: On a monthly power bill of $200, the annual increase would work out to $156.

canada.title: Alberta reducing need for sciences, humanities courses to graduate high school
canada.summary: The government's new requirements mean that students will only need to complete one senior level course in either English or social studies, while senior level math and science classes will still not be mandatory.

canada.title: 2 workers critically injured in collision on Pickering construction site: police
canada.summary: Two workers are critically injured after being struck by a driver on a construction site in Pickering, police say.

canada.title: Canadian government investing $200M in B.C.’s Woodfibre LNG
canada.summary: The Woodfibre LNG facility, near Squamish, will receive natural gas, cool it into liquefied natural gas, where it will be loaded onto specialized LNG carriers and exported overseas
